Josh Gates explores the tombs of the world, uncovering history’s greatest burial mysteries across continents and civilizations. Every investigation follows him across the globe as he tracks down legendary lost tombs like Genghis Khan, Attila the Hun, Viking kings, ancient pyramids, and even Alexander the Great, mixing real history with clues and discoveries to figure out what might actually be hidden there.

Josh Gates explores mysteries in American History! The episodes explore unresolved historical events such as a man’s confession about Abraham Lincoln’s assassination, deadly and unpredictable forecasting incidents like the Donner Party trapped in the Sierra Nevada mountains, major cover-ups involving a secret American unit called the Ghost Army that carried out deception operations against the Nazis, and high-pressure crises involving anthrax.
